text: ちいさなキノコを　２こか　おおきなキノコを　１こ　くれたら　きみの　ポケモンに　わざを　おしえて　あげるよ！

structure.jp: ちいさなキノコを　２こか
おおきなキノコを　１こ　くれたら
structure.en: if you give me one Big Mushroom

structure.jp: きみの　ポケモンに　わざを　おしえて　あげるよ！
structure.en: I'll teach your Pokémon a move!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. １こ くれたら = 'if you give me one'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form says the speaker does the thing as a favour for someone. おしえて あげる = 'I'll teach it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜か (or)
patterns.explanation: か between two choices means 'or'. ２こか = 'two of them, or'.
